name: capsule-trends
description: Test additions against the wardrobe you own.

interface.longDescription: Test additions against the wardrobe you own. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Count compatible wardrobe combinations; Check a potential wardrobe addition; Compare new and secondhand costs. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me count compatible wardrobe combinations.
Help me check a potential wardrobe addition.

prompts: Help me count compatible wardrobe combinations.
Help me check a potential wardrobe addition.
Help me compare new and secondhand costs.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Closet Compass: Capsule workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Count compatible wardrobe combinations. Reproducible inputs: {"tops":[{"name":"White tee","palette":"neutral"}],"bottoms":[{"name":"Black jeans","palette":"neutral"},{"name":"Navy chinos","palette":"neutral"}],"shoes":[{"name":"Sneakers","palette":"neutral"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me count compatible wardrobe combinations with these supplied values: {"tops":[{"name":"White tee","palette":"neutral"}],"bottoms":[{"name":"Black jeans","palette":"neutral"},{"name":"Navy chinos","palette":"neutral"}],"shoes":[{"name":"Sneakers","palette":"neutral"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses capsule_trends_capsule_combinations with the supplied inputs. Returns {"count":2,"outfits":[{"top":"White tee","bottom":"Black jeans","shoes":"Sneakers"},{"top":"White tee","bottom":"Navy chinos","shoes":"Sneakers"}],"note":"Compatibility uses your shared palette tags; no image-based styling inference."}. Shows the actual wardrobe result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Check a potential wardrobe addition. Reproducible inputs: {"candidate":"Striped shirt","candidate_tags":["top","cotton","blue"],"wardrobe":[{"name":"Blue oxford","tags":["top","cotton","blue"]},{"name":"Black jeans","tags":["bottom","denim"]}]}
positive.prompt: Help me check a potential wardrobe addition with these supplied values: {"candidate":"Striped shirt","candidate_tags":["top","cotton","blue"],"wardrobe":[{"name":"Blue oxford","tags":["top","cotton","blue"]},{"name":"Black jeans","tags":["bottom","denim"]}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses capsule_trends_addition_overlap with the supplied inputs. Returns {"candidate":"Striped shirt","comparisons":[{"name":"Blue oxford","shared_tags":["top","cotton","blue"],"overlap_fraction":1},{"name":"Black jeans","shared_tags":[],"overlap_fraction":0}]}. Shows the actual matrix result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare new and secondhand costs. Reproducible inputs: {"options":[{"name":"New jacket","price":140,"care_cost":20,"expected_wears":80},{"name":"Secondhand jacket","price":60,"care_cost":30,"expected_wears":60}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare new and secondhand costs with these supplied values: {"options":[{"name":"New jacket","price":140,"care_cost":20,"expected_wears":80},{"name":"Secondhand jacket","price":60,"care_cost":30,"expected_wears":60}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses capsule_trends_cost_per_wear with the supplied inputs. Returns {"options":[{"name":"Secondhand jacket","price":60,"care_cost":30,"expected_wears":60,"total":90,"cost_per_wear":1.5},{"name":"New jacket","price":140,"care_cost":20,"expected_wears":80,"total":160,"cost_per_wear":2}]}. Shows the actual budget result. Does not fabricate external data.
